question: Should `optimizeImages`, typed Opus output/duration controls, and strict base64 parsing be accepted as permanent public Plugin SDK media capabilities in order to remove WhatsApp’s local media implementation?
rationale: The patch is mechanically focused, but a Plugin SDK expansion and intentional removal of a local-file fallback affect external plugin compatibility and cannot be settled from tests alone.

options.title: Accept the shared media contract
options.body: Treat the added SDK capabilities as supported public APIs, retain the explicit-root requirement, and merge after rebase plus final WhatsApp delivery proof.

options.title: Keep the contract private
options.body: Move the new controls behind an owner-private or generic internal seam and keep the public SDK surface unchanged before merging.

options.title: Defer the refactor
options.body: Pause the PR until maintainers choose the long-term Plugin SDK media boundary and upgrade expectations.

recommendation.title: Accept the shared media contract
recommendation.body: Treat the added SDK capabilities as supported public APIs, retain the explicit-root requirement, and merge after rebase plus final WhatsApp delivery proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the recent contributor across both the production media refactor and adjacent WhatsApp validation work, making them the best available routing candidate for the design discussion.
